title: Price in Force for the Pass-Through Cycle on C&I Fixed-Price Lines
content:
For Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, the cycle's price in force follows the notice period the pass-through owed, the notice-period day being the one that falls the structure's regulatory change notice days after the notice date: on a structure that does not allow a regulatory pass-through, or when the notice date falls fewer than those days before the stated effective date and the pass-through cycle ends before the notice-period day, the cycle keeps the contract rate; when the notice date falls fewer than those days before the stated effective date and the cycle runs past the notice-period day, the cycle's price in force is the day-weighted average of the contract rate over the cycle's days before that day and the notice's new contract price over its remaining days, taken over the cycle's billing days and not rounded; otherwise the cycle takes the notice's new contract price.

| Structure | Regulatory pass-through allowed | Regulatory change notice days |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | no | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | yes | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | no | 30 |

The days before the notice-period day are the cycle's days from its first day up to the day before the notice-period day; the remaining days are the cycle's billing days less those days.

## Cases (hypothetical: contract rate 7.50, new contract price 7.20, cents per kWh)

| Structure allows | Notice date | Stated effective date and cycle start | Notice-period day | Billing days | Price in force |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 15 May 2026 | 1 June 2026 (17 days later) | 14 June 2026 | 30 | 7.50 multiplied by 13, plus 7.20 multiplied by 17, divided by 30: 7.33 |
| yes | 15 May 2026 | 1 June 2026 | 14 June 2026 | 12, cycle ending 12 June | 7.50 |
| yes | 1 May 2026 | 1 June 2026 (31 days later) | not needed | 30 | 7.20 |
| no | any | any | not needed | any | 7.50 |
